created_from.source_note: Ordered screenshot PDF is not a full item export: activity_04 and child_02 through child_05 evidenced only in CSV.

matching.duplicate_header_resolution: (exact header text, occurrence_index_1based) after full ordered header match
matching.field_id_stability: GF_NNN refers to this version original CSV column; new questionnaire requires versioned schema, not in-place positional remap

field_grid.multirow_alignment: each label stays with corresponding answer, no horizontally mismatched rows

layout.repeated_records: one subgroup per item with source ordinal preserved

types.date_raw: accept DD/MM/YYYY and YYYY-MM-DD; validate actual calendar; save ISO plus raw; no guessing if ambiguous
types.timestamp_raw: preserve_raw_timestamp; parse only with explicit locale/timezone
types.yes_no_raw: map Sim/Não to true/false in normalized layer; preserve raw text
types.choice_raw: preserve raw option string; do not split comma-separated answers without configured option vocabulary
types.phone: preserve plus signs and leading zeros; validate softly
types.email: preserve and validate syntax without changing case of local-part
types.file_reference_raw: preserve raw Google Forms value; store file list only after verified parsing; simulated placeholder not a real attachment
types.multiline_text: preserve line breaks, do not AI-infer unsupported details

validation_rules.check: all columns matched by identity; otherwise no import
no dictionary import keyed by raw header alone
calendar date valid when supplied; invalid dates are unresolved
review gaps and overlapping periods; current employment not assumed ended
branch says not applicable but raw value provided
if any of security.crime_history, security.security_or_military_history, security.immigration_issues, security.visa_overstay is yes, positive_answer_details required
third-party payer should have sponsor reference/details; supporting uploads may follow later
SIMULADO_NAO_ANEXADO is not an actual uploaded file
keep exact source header, corrected UI label

known_limitations: Screenshot PDF does not expose Google Forms item IDs, all routing rules, or complete branching graph.
PDF documents 3 activity pages and 1 child page; CSV exports 4 activity blocks and 5 child blocks.
Requirement marker (*) not reliably verified for all 235 columns; review_when_applicable is a workflow choice, not official IRCC necessity.
Source header GF_129 mistakenly names parent 1 in parent 2 section; import key intentionally unchanged.
Former-partner applicability is inferred from marital choices and prior-relationship flag; confirm actual Google Form routing via API.
The sponsor third-party condition covers known payer answers; custom Other payer must be reviewed.
CSV alone contains no reliable Google Forms response ID or edit URLs; create stable internal application IDs and record original timestamp.
File uploads in Google Forms may require authorized Google Drive access; raw CSV references alone do not prove file availability.
This mapping does not establish equivalence to current official IRCC requirements or enable visa submission.
